unit_title: Digital Identity, Information, and AI Literacy
standards: Michigan Computer Science: Impacts of Computing

prompts.prompt: Explain privacy and data trails in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of platform incentives.
Apply algorithmic recommendations in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving misinformation and synthetic media; correct it and explain why.
Connect privacy and data trails with copyright and attribution. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Create an evidence-based guide to responsible research and AI-assisted work with transparent verification.
